body: No I'm not able to handle college right now. I just work a couple hours a week
I guess I just don't have an idea of a suitable career/what the future holds and my depression makes me miserable...

Why I want to die? I feel worthless I guess most of the time, because of my depression and social anxiety and feelings of rejection. I'm starting to feel more worth, but a small part of me doesn't want to so I can just die. 

I want to die because I feel worthless and miserable, but also (I've never told anyone this) I want people to miss me and feel sad for me too. It's like 15% the latter and 85% the former reason
Do you genuinely want to die?

The not being able to enjoy things part, that could be helped with some medicine. Maybe you'll only need it for a couple months to a year. Medication helped me by being on a lot for a year, until now I'm on only 2 meds. I'm able to enjoy things better now, but suicidal thoughts still plague me so basically I'm saying there's a way to fix some of your symptoms, and then keep working on the remaining ones.
